evidence.dom: 『Autoliv is the clear market leader in passive safety...with an estimated global market share of around 44%』『global market share was unchanged at around 44% in 2025』『seatbelts...global market share of around 45%』→寡占40-69%=70
evidence.irr: 『contracts...do not typically provide minimum quantities, firm prices, or exclusivity but instead permit the automobile manufacturer to resource the relevant products』一方『delivery contract is typically for the lifetime of a vehicle model』+安全部品の検証/認証摩擦→高摩擦移行困難だが排他契約なし=70
evidence.rep: 『increase its global market share in passive safety from 27% in 1997 to around 44% in 2025』(約30年の蓄積)『superior global footprint both in products and engineering』だが『ZF AG...global leader...as well as in passive safety』等実在の競合が残余シェア保有→困難だが複製不能ではない=60
evidence.dur: 『delivery contract...for the lifetime of a vehicle model, normally between five a[nd]...years』(モデル寿命=スイッチングコスト)+安全規制(『India has required frontal airbags for the driver since July 2019』UN1958)→スイッチングコスト主体=75
evidence.erosion: 『The Company estimates that its global market share was unchanged at around 44% in 2025 compared to 2024』『order intake in 2025 supports the Company's ability to defend its around 44% sales market share in the near and medium term』→蝕なし=none(中国系OEM台頭は注視)
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションに技術代替のキーワードヒットなし。エアバッグ/シートベルト=物理受動安全に技術破壊なくCPV増(『content per vehicle』成長)→settled
evidence.expiry: 『held more than 6,600 patents...expire on various dates during the period from 2026 to 2045』だが『The expiration of any single patent is not expected to have a material adverse effect』→期限型独占ではない=no
evidence.moatdecay: 『increase its global market share...to around 44% in 2025』シェア安定+CPV/LVP成長(『LVP...increased at an average annual growth rate of around 1.9% since...1997』)→no

evidence.geopol_concentration: 『top five customers represented around 44% of consolidated sales, and our largest customer contract accounted for around 2%』→顧客分散良好(最大契約2%)で集中懸念は限定的

evidence.p4: accr=-4.9(<0)+『Item 1B Unresolved Staff Comments None』。material weaknessヒットは『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists』=監査手続の定型文で実指摘ではない→無限定相当=90
evidence.f1: ROIIC(2023→25): ΔNOPAT≈286M(税後営利552→838)/ΔIC≈318M(のれん除きIC 2,005→2,323)≒90%だが循環的マージン正常化(2023営利690が起点で歪み)+再投資率低位(capex漸減・還元主体)→保守的に80
evidence.f2: 受動安全TAMは先進国成熟・新興国でCPV/義務化拡大(『India's importance...risen from around 2%...in 2020 to 5% in 2025』)。低一桁浸透ではなく成熟寄り→<60%相当で保守65

evidence.moatW: 製品別売上(FY2025 10-K『Segment Information - Net Sales by Product』, 総額$10,815百万): エアバッグ・ステアリングホイール$7,302百万=67.5% / シートベルト$3,513百万=32.5%(いずれもCorporate等を含む)。顧客集中(10-K『DEPENDENCE ON CUSTOMERS』): 最大顧客Stellantis 9.8%、Toyota 9.6%、VW 9.0%、Honda 8.3%、Hyundai 7.0%、上位5社44%、上位10社70%。『largest customer contract accounted for around 2% of consolidated sales』。地域: 欧州29% / 米州32% / 中国19% / 中国除くアジア20%。→ 独立した堀は1本と判定: エアバッグもシートベルトも同一のパッシブセーフティ事業で、顧客(同じ自動車OEM)・技術基盤(衝突安全の試験/検証ノウハウ)・OEM認証プロセス・車種ライフ契約の仕組みが完全に共通。OEMのソーシング方針や衝突安全規制が変われば両方に同時に効く＝1本。ただし最大顧客9.8%(<10%)かつ単一製品67.5%(<70%)で、用途/顧客/地域とも分散 → 70。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 (alv-20251231.htm) R119、Item1 Dependence on Customers、Item7
